## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what this change makes possible.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test` for behavior changes, or explain why it is not applicable
- [ ] `npm run catalog:check`; regenerate and commit the catalog if tool definitions changed
- [ ] Documentation links, examples and configuration modes checked where applicable
- [ ] No local credentials, generated panels, or private Adobe project files included

For host-facing changes, list the Adobe application version and platform. State whether validation used a simulated host or a native application, and document any remaining limitations.

For installer changes, report the portable build/smoke test and Windows bootstrap regression result where applicable. Documentation-only changes can use formatting, local link checks and catalog freshness validation.
